cover: Gulf tanker explosion, nationwide French unrest, and sample return mission shake global headlines
cover_scene: A split composition featuring a burning oil tanker on darkened ocean waters alongside smoke rising over historic European rooftops under an ominous night sky.

slides.scene: A massive oil tanker engulfed in flames and dense black smoke south of the Strait of Hormuz at night, naval patrol vessels patrolling the perimeter in rough seas.
slides.headline: Supertanker Explodes Near Strait of Hormuz
slides.body: A supertanker carrying over two million barrels of crude oil exploded south of the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine. Iranian forces reported the vessel had turned off tracking systems, escalating fears over shipping security.

slides.scene: Riot police holding protective shields facing a burning vehicle on a wide boulevard in central Paris, smoke billowing toward classical stone facades.
slides.headline: France Imposes Curfews Amid Nationwide Riots
slides.body: French officials declared overnight curfews in Paris, Nice, and other cities after intense protests and rioting destroyed Limoges town hall. Authorities vowed an unrelenting police crackdown as Donald Trump publicly linked the civil unrest to French immigration policies.

slides.scene: A wooden ballot box placed in a quiet Canadian municipal hall, flanked by the national maple leaf flag and provincial crests under overhead lights.
slides.headline: Alberta Decisively Rejects Separatist Independence Referendum
slides.body: Voters in Alberta overwhelmingly rejected a referendum proposal to separate from Canada. The decisive defeat halts the oil-rich province's immediate push for sovereignty, handing federal authorities a major political victory while leaving regional political divides unresolved.

slides.scene: A towering Japanese space rocket lifting off through thick exhaust plumes from an oceanfront launch pad into starry black space toward Mars.
slides.headline: Japan Launches Martian Moon Sample Return
slides.body: Japan successfully launched a historic mission to land on Phobos, the largest moon of Mars, to collect pristine rock and soil. Scientists aim to return the extraterrestrial samples to Earth to decipher the early origins of our solar system.

slides.scene: Two massive European soccer stadiums viewed under bright stadium floodlights at dusk, empty executive seats overlooking pristine green pitches.
slides.headline: Barcelona Severs Relations With Real Madrid
slides.body: Barcelona president Joan Laporta announced the club has cut all official ties with rivals Real Madrid, calling the feud a direct confrontation. Laporta criticized Madrid's involvement in the Negreira refereeing court case, dramatically souring relations between Spain's two biggest clubs.
